request: このマウスのサイドボタン、もっと押しやすく。外形はできるだけ変えないで。試作では仮のスイッチ外形を使い、実スイッチ寸法・押下力・クリック感は未確定として残す。

preference: 外形はできるだけ変えないで

2_reference_inspection.reason: No PCB/shell/switch STEP was provided; the recipe uses an explicit stand-in shell and placeholder switch.

3_function_decomposition.behavior: Thumb force on the side skin reaches the button body without the skin flexing away.
The button moves on one controlled path without rattling against the shell.
The plunger pushes the switch stem through its operating travel.
The button returns to rest after release.
Travel ends at a defined limit (a hard stop, or the switch pin bottoming when no stop is used) and stays inside the checked range.
The button and its guide are carried by the shell while the outer skin stays unchanged.
3_function_decomposition.function: connect to shell without changing outer form

7_engineering_evaluation.reason: Revision 18 after the five-role review of revision 17 (no blocking findings): the rest pose is set by a preloaded lip on the inner skin and the travel ends on a printed jaw keyed into a shell post after the worst-case click, so rest and stop no longer depend on the carrier placement; the carrier is located by two pins 15.7 mm apart (block and tongue) on an upper-tab Z datum with a back-stop lip; the insert has a pull notch and a short press band; leaves 0.6 +/- 0.05 mm judged at the worst case; an ASSUMED PCB slab, placement-tolerance corners, poses from the rest pose and corner presses at the stop are checked.
